title: NEXUS wire primitives
description: Shared primitives for every NEXUS contract object. Source: docs/API_CONTRACT.md §1 (global conventions: JSON only, snake_case keys, ISO-8601 UTC, money as string decimal) and §2 (GeoPoint / Money). Not a stand-alone payload: consumers $ref these definitions.

snake_case_key.description: API_CONTRACT §1: all JSON keys are snake_case. Applied via `propertyNames` to every open object in the contract (attributes, details, properties, filters).

uuid_or_null.description: Nullable id. spec §8: an unknown reference is `null`, never a placeholder value.

iso_date_time_or_null.description: Absent-in-time marker. `null` means 'the user/row said nothing', which is different from 'no end' — see API_CONTRACT §7.1.

currency_code.description: ISO-4217. V1 `tenants.currency` default `HKD`; AGENT_CONTRACT §12. Currency is always carried next to an amount — there is no implicit HKD on the wire.

money_amount.description: API_CONTRACT §1 'money as string decimal'. A float must never carry a price (V1 columns are `numeric(12,2)` / `numeric(10,6)`).

PriceSource.title: PriceSource
PriceSource.description: V1__init.sql `offerings.price_source` (line 227). Note the deliberate difference from `facts.source`: the offerings table says `estimated` where the fact table says `inferred` (CONTRACT NOTES 6 in `src/enums.ts`).

Price.title: Price
Price.description: API_CONTRACT §2 `EntityCard.price` = `{amount, currency, model}`; extends `Money` with the V1 price columns so a rendered price carries its model and provenance (AGENT_CONTRACT §5 price TTL is 6h and source-dependent).

stale.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §5: a stale price is shown with 「价格可能已更新」 and re-checked at checkout (API_CONTRACT §6).

GeoPoint.title: GeoPoint
GeoPoint.description: API_CONTRACT §2 `GeoPoint` = `{ "lat": 22.3809, "lng": 114.1861 }`; V1 `locations.lat/lng numeric(9,6)`. Precise geo requires user consent (AGENT_CONTRACT §1 `location`).

ImageAsset.title: ImageAsset
ImageAsset.description: API_CONTRACT §2 `EntityCard.image` = `{url, alt, credit}`. `credit: "synthetic"` is the honesty marker for seeded artwork (DECISIONS D6, spec §109).

smoothed.description: True when `value` is the Bayesian-smoothed quality score, not the raw mean (AGENT_CONTRACT §6).

DistanceInfo.title: DistanceInfo
DistanceInfo.description: API_CONTRACT §2 `EntityCard.distance` = `{meters, text, travel_minutes}`; computed server-side so every surface renders the same label.

from.description: Origin the distance was measured from. Never echoed when it is precise client geo (spec §112, AGENT_CONTRACT §10 `geo_precision`).

JsonObject.title: JsonObject
JsonObject.description: Any `jsonb` map the contracts leave open (`attributes`, `filters`, `details`, `properties`, `context`). Keys stay snake_case (API_CONTRACT §1).

ConfidenceMap.title: ConfidenceMap
ConfidenceMap.description: Per-field extraction confidence, 0..1 — API_CONTRACT §7.1 `{category:0.95, budget:0.9, time:0.8}`. AGENT_CONTRACT §4: below 0.6 the copy hedges, below 0.4 the field is dropped and handoff offered. Never rounded up for presentation.

SupportedLocale.title: SupportedLocale
SupportedLocale.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §12 (`zh-HK` default, plus `en`, `zh-CN`); mirrored by `SUPPORTED_LOCALE` in `src/enums.ts`. TS `Locale` stays an open string because V1 `tenants.locales text[]` may add more, but the schema is the closed v1 registry.
